title: Editorial checks admin panel
description:
Administration → Editorial checks panel.

## Scope
- Policy list: enable, severity, scope (publication/section), version history.
- Detector editor: rules (regex/lexicon/phrase/builtin) and classifier (question type, instructions, criteria, threshold, review band, examples).
- "Draft questions from guideline" button (Luna) → editor reviews/edits proposed classifier detectors before saving.
- "Try it" box: run one policy against pasted text, show matches and Jev probability.
- Settings tab bound to `EditorialCheckSettings`.
- One-time import of `publications/*/style-profile.yml` into policies.
- Lives next to `AdministrationPoliciesPanel` in `components/topic-steering-workspace.tsx` (consider extracting into its own component file).
